scope: Replace raw Playwright trace capture in the opt-in live feedback visual path with a single screenshot that masks input, textarea, select and explicitly marked data-sensitive regions. Keep visual capture opt-in and remove DOM snapshots from this path.

acceptance.standard_form_controls_are_masked: PASS - Chromium pixel checks confirm synthetic password and demographic controls are covered by opaque masks.
acceptance.explicit_sensitive_regions_are_masked: PASS - Chromium pixel check confirms a synthetic token region marked data-sensitive is covered by an opaque mask.
acceptance.raw_dom_trace_is_not_saved: PASS - session-level test makes any trace start/stop fail and confirms no trace.zip is created.
acceptance.default_capture_remains_disabled: PASS - visual capture remains behind the existing --visuals opt-in.
acceptance.issue_requirement_complete: false - arbitrary sensitive values rendered as ordinary page text cannot be reliably identified by generic field masking.

test_first_red.observation: The initial shell Python could not import Playwright; rerunning with the repository .venv then failed because capture_redacted_screenshot did not exist. After implementation, the regression passed.

commands.notes: A pre-existing feedback GUI browser test printed a transient Windows WinError 10053 after its HTTP client disconnected; all 21 tests completed successfully.

commands.command: python -m tools.verification.agent_skills; python -m tools.verification.catalogue; python -m tools.verification.progress validate; python -m tools.coordination.lane_coordination validate; git diff --check

environment.browser: local headless Chromium with synthetic in-memory page; no external navigation
environment.database: NOT_APPLICABLE - capture configuration and filesystem artifact behavior only; session files written under temporary directory during tests

limitations: Issue #181 / MJ-REQ-180 remains OPEN/PARTIAL; only the live feedback visual capture path is addressed.

Standard browser form controls and explicitly marked data-sensitive regions are masked, but generic code cannot classify every sensitive value rendered as ordinary page text; screenshot review is still required before sharing.
The separate explicit --diagnostic-text option remains an opt-in path for console/page-error text and was not changed by this slice.
No full repository suite, frontend build, PostgreSQL runtime, Docker workflow, hosted CI/review or external application flow was run.
